title: Return policy
text: Most items can be returned within 30 days of delivery if they are unused and in the original packaging. Electronics (headphones, speakers, chargers, smartwatches) have a shorter 15-day return window. Opened software and gift cards cannot be returned. To start a return, go to Orders > Return Item.

title: Refunds
text: Refunds are issued to the original payment method within 5-7 business days after the returned item reaches our warehouse. Original shipping fees are not refunded, except when the item arrived damaged or we sent the wrong item.

title: Shipping options
text: Standard shipping takes 5-7 business days and costs $4.99. Standard shipping is free for orders over $50. Express shipping takes 2 business days and costs $12.99. We currently ship only within the United States and Canada.

title: Cancelling an order
text: Orders can be cancelled within 2 hours of being placed, as long as they have not shipped yet. After an order has shipped it cannot be cancelled, but it can be returned once delivered.

title: Warranty
text: All electronics come with a 1-year limited warranty covering manufacturing defects. The warranty does not cover accidental damage, water damage or normal wear. Warranty claims need the order ID and a photo of the problem.

title: Damaged or wrong items
text: If an item arrives damaged or you received the wrong item, contact support within 7 days of delivery with a photo. We will send a free replacement or give a full refund including shipping fees.

title: Payment methods
text: We accept Visa, Mastercard, American Express, PayPal and store gift cards. We do not accept cash on delivery or cryptocurrency.
